name: Teleprompter.com
description:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and Claude can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What Claude can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because Claude can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and the consent screen lets you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice if that's all you want. Claude only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Teleprompter.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Teleprompter.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.teleprompter.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Teleprompter.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teleprompter.com provides these MCP tools: create_folder, create_script, get_folder, get_script, list_folders, list_scripts, list_scripts_in_folder, move_script, update_folder, and update_script.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Teleprompter.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Teleprompter.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Teleprompter.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Teleprompter.com is developed by Teleprompter LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
